rationale: Official Prozorro tender search UI — durable, public, primary A2 surface for UA banking/payments procurement.
Public REST change-feed over all tenders/awards; machine-readable backbone for repeatable collection.
Versioned API schema docs on its own domain — reference needed to build and maintain the collector.
Developer index section of prozorro.gov.ua; mine once for endpoints, covered by the portal/API entries.
Canonical CPV/ДК021 classifier reference data, independently versioned; required for the banking/payments filter set.
Daily-refreshed public BI over all Prozorro spend; standalone tool for sizing categories and ranking buyers/vendors.
Professional BI tier likely gated; valuable for supplier share analysis once access is cleared.
ДАСУ audit/monitoring API on its own host; adds contested/cancelled procurement risk signals.
E-catalogue covers below-threshold hardware/IT buying invisible to tender search; distinct producing surface.
Spec-template registry would reveal buyer technical requirements, but URL did not verify — recheck liveness.
Official knowledge base for procedures/thresholds; interpretive reference, low-frequency but durable.
CDB source repo — authoritative on field semantics and release changes when docs lag.
Statutory open-data publication of procurement data; bulk export route plus legal-basis anchor.
NGO tools directory best mined once for derived sources; URL did not verify, recheck before mining.
Joins tenders to EDRPOU registry data — fastest CPV-hit-to-vendor-profile route, continuously useful.
Third-party Prozorro mirror; scrape-friendly fallback only, redundant with the official API.
Authorised broker also carrying commercial (non-state) tenders — route to private bank demand.
Redundant broker mirror; keep only if CPV subscription alerts prove useful.
Broker with guide content, low unique value and unverified URL; recheck later.
Prozorro.Sale open data covers bank/DGF asset disposals — adjacent but in-sector, own API surface.
Treasury payments view closes award-vs-paid loop; valuable but URL unverified, recheck liveness.
Authoritative list of authorised marketplaces — mine once to bound the legitimate mirror set.
Largest accredited marketplace with a commercial stream absent from the state CDB; high-value standalone feed.
Commercial listing section of zakupki.prom.ua; the target crawl path, covered by monitoring the parent domain.
